personality_one_liner: A precision-engineered mobile point-of-sale and business command center combining Apple-grade clarity with robust offline-first merchant operations.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical rhythm with comfortable touch targets and clear grouping.

do's: Use frosted glass for sticky search headers and bottom action sheets
Pair blur with translucent light tint for absolute clarity
dont's: Never blur dense lists or form fields
Do not stack more than two glass layers simultaneously

screens.name: POSCheckout
screens.purpose: Lightning-fast catalog browsing, barcode scanning, cart management, and multi-tender checkout.

states.loading: Skeleton product grid and shimmering cart summary.
states.empty: Illustrated empty cart with prompt to scan barcode or browse categories.
states.error: Banner alert with retry button for scanner or payment gateway sync.

screens.layout: Sticky category chips at top, 2-column touch-friendly product grid with real PNG logos, slide-up cart bottom drawer with instant QRIS/Cash/Wallet toggles and sticky bottom checkout CTA.

screens.name: InventoryStock
screens.purpose: Comprehensive stock management, low-stock alerts, supplier pricing, and Excel import/export.

states.empty: Empty state with button to import from Excel or add first product.

screens.layout: Search bar with barcode scanner shortcut, filter pills (All, Low Stock, Out of Stock), list of items with stock badge and quick adjust stepper.

screens.name: ReportsAnalytics
screens.purpose: Daily, monthly, and yearly sales analytics, profit margin breakdown, and cash flow balance.

states.loading: Shimmering metric cards and chart placeholders.
states.empty: No transaction data for selected period.
states.error: Failed to load report metrics. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Segmented period toggle (Daily/Monthly/Yearly), KPI cards grid, interactive summary chart, and export-to-WhatsApp/Excel share sheet.

screens.name: OperatorRoles
screens.purpose: Admin control center to manage cashiers/operators, assign permissions, and monitor activity logs.

states.empty: No operators registered yet. Add cashier.

screens.layout: List of staff cards with role badges (Admin, Cashier, Kitchen, Inventory), permission toggle switches, and 'Add Operator' sticky button.

screens.name: ReceiptSettings
screens.purpose: Configure 58mm & 80mm thermal printers via Bluetooth, company logo upload, and kitchen printer routing.

states.loading: Scanning for nearby Bluetooth thermal printers...
states.empty: No printers paired. Tap scan to discover 58mm/80mm devices.
states.error: Bluetooth connection timeout. Check printer power.

screens.layout: Paired devices list, paper size selector (58mm / 80mm), company logo preview box, kitchen printer routing toggles, and 'Test Print' action.

pos_hero.alt: Modern point of sale counter with clean terminal

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure lightning-fast tactile response on POS sales grid, barcode scanner simulation, multi-printer Bluetooth dispatch, WhatsApp receipt share, and Excel import handling. Follow iOS-native clean styling with generous touch targets (>=44pt) and flawless safe-area handling.
